title: SARS-CoV-2 Sequencing on Illumina MiSeq Using ARTIC Protocol: Part 1 - Tiling PCR
author: Joel Sevinsky

materials: [ ] In a PCR hood, mix the following reagents and add to a 0.2 mL PCR tube on a cold block plus 11 µL of RNA sample: Each reaction should have 13 µL when mixed. If using master mix, it is recommended to add the 2 µL of the master mix to the PCR tube first, then add the 11 µL of RNA to help prevent contamination. [ ] Preheat Thermocycler to 65 °C , with heated lid at 105 °C

[ ] In a clean 1.5 mL LoBind tube (96 well plates can also be used) on On ice , mix together the following reagents: **Note: All these reagents are part of the SuperScript IV Reverse Transcriptase kit. RNaseOUT™ Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #10777019 Lot# _______________ Exp. [ ] Preheat thermocycler to 42 °C , with heated lid at 105 °C

[ ] Set up two individual reactions using primer pool A and primer pool B in 0.2 mL PCR tubes according to the following table: **See protocol on primer design for SARS-CoV-2. If this is your first attempt, it would be best to receive aliquots of the primers from a lab that has successfully sequenced SARS-CoV-2 first. Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix - 100 rxns New England Biolabs Catalog #M0494S Lot# _______________ Exp. Date _______________ RT-PCR Grade Water Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM9935 Lot# _______________ Exp. Date _______________ Any PCR grade water will do in this step. Not necessary to use the reagent listed.
[ ] Mix gently and spin down prior to loading on the thermocycler.

[ ] Run the following thermocycler program: **Note: If starting RNA samples had a qPCR Ct value in the range of 12-21, use 25 cycles. If starting RNA samples had a qPCR Ct values in the range of 21-35, use 35 cycles. An alternative approach that has been successful that helps with througput is to run every specimen undiluted and for 35 cycles, and only if it fails to sequence correctly go back and dilute and/or run for fewer cycles. Some labs have been reporting that greater than 90% of their specimens will sequence fine undiluted for 35 cycles.

[ ] Quantify eluted sample on Qubit fluorometer or similar instrument and store completed PCR amplified cDNA prep at -20 °C . Qubit Fluorometer (Fluorometer, Invitrogen, Q33238, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/Q33238#/Q33238 ) Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 Earlier versions of the Qubit, or any other method for accurate DNA quantitation can be used. Most labs should have this equipment available in their NGS sections.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute nucleic acid/RNA extractions from qPCR diagnostic tests based on their Ct values using the Initial Sample Dilution Sheet. If Ct values are unavailable, samples may be used undiluted.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Convert RNA to cDNA using the COVID WGS Reverse Transcription program.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently, spin down, and keep on ice
Incubate the reaction at 65 °C for 00:05:00
Snap-cool on ice for at least 00:01:00
Add 7 µL of master mix to the cooled RNA sample
Mix gently by flicking, spin down, and return to ice
Incubate sample using the COVID WGS Reverse Transcription program

steps.title: Initiate Tiled PCR
steps.instruction: Distribute the synthesized cDNA into the primer pools.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of sample cDNA to each pool (Pool A and Pool B)

steps.title: Combine PCR Products
steps.instruction: Merge the reactions from the two pools into a single tube.

substeps.instruction: Combine the 25 µL reaction from Pool A and the 25 µL reaction from Pool B into a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Fisher Scientific Catalog #13-698-791)

steps.title: Perform Bead Clean-Up and Size Selection
steps.instruction: Purify the combined DNA using AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter Catalog #A63881).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing
Add 50 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the reaction and mix
Incubate on a rotator mixer for 00:10:00 at room temperature
Prepare 80% volume ethanol (Calculation: 0.5ml x Sample# = Total Volume; Total Volume x 0.8 = mL EtOH; Total Volume - mL EtOH = mL H2O)
Spin down sample and pellet beads on a magnet for approximately 00:05:00
Pipette off supernatant while keeping tubes on the magnet
Wash beads with 200 µL freshly prepared 80% volume EtOH without disturbing the pellet; rotate tube to migrate pellet to the opposite side, then remove EtOH
Spin down and place tubes back on the magnet, pipette off residual ethanol, and air dry for approximately 00:00:30 (do not over dry)
Remove tubes from magnet and resuspend pellet in 30 µL of nuclease-free water
Incubate at room temperature for approximately 00:02:00
Pellet the beads on a magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless
Remove ~30 µL of eluate and place in a clean 1.5 mL LoBind tube
